subject: Ice sheet
hook: ICE SHEET IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Ice sheets are actually warmer at their base than at the surface, and that meltwater lubricates the base causing the ice to flow faster
angle_support: "Although the surface is cold, the base of an ice sheet is generally warmer by means of geothermal heat."
"In places, melting occurs and the melt-water lubricates the ice sheet so that it flows more rapidly."
title: Why Ice Sheets Actually Slide
description: Ice sheets are not just frozen static masses. They are dynamic systems kept in motion by geothermal heat melting their undersides.
narration: ICE SHEET IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You imagine a frozen, solid block. It was closer to a sliding machine. We assume the surface is the coldest part, but the base is actually warmer. Geothermal heat warms the bottom, creating meltwater. This liquid acts like a lubricant between the ice and the ground. This flow is so efficient that it creates fast-moving channels within the ice sheet known as ice streams. The ground beneath the ice is often much wetter than expected.
